mode_note: FROZEN over the ANALYSIS RULE before any confirmatory stream exists. source_refs and source_set_digest are bound by a dated addendum committed BEFORE the first replay of the sealed streams; an addendum that postdates a replay voids this manifest (WP-X1 refusal 3). The 2026-09-11 dead-stream control (5 seeds, 16-item caps) is DIAGNOSTIC and is not a source here.
claim: bounded behavioral/random retention (hybrid) improves PROSPECTIVE UTILITY on a sealed future-task manifest relative to top-K, uniform and behavioral-only retention, at identical item and byte caps

source_refs.form: ordered list, one per seed: (stream_manifest.stream_digest, assay_ref, descriptors_manifest_digest, future_tasks_manifest_digest); never a query

already_fixed.stream_format: archaeon/docs/h0h5/H3_STREAM_FORMAT.md v0 (archaeon.producer.h3_replay.Candidate; failed rows STAY in the stream)

source_set_digest: BOUND_AT_SEAL: sha256 over the canonicalised, sorted source_refs

unit_of_analysis.unit: the STREAM SEED: one independently generated candidate stream, replayed through all four policies (paired across arms within the seed)
unit_of_analysis.mapping_rule: one unit per stream seed; the 12 future queries are WITHIN-unit repeats and add no units; a policy's per-seed value is its solve fraction over ALL 12 queries
unit_of_analysis.declared_n: n_seeds, fixed at seal; MINIMUM 6 (min_attainable_p 0.031 <= 0.05); 5 seeds is NOTHING_COULD_FIRE and is reported as such
unit_of_analysis.denominator: all 12 sealed queries per seed, including queries no archive answers

measurement_identity.definition: fraction of the sealed future queries the frozen archive answers under the declared rule (score_at_least at the query's threshold; cell queries per H3_FUTURE_QUERIES_v1); a query is answered or not, never partially
measurement_identity.not_pooled_with: archive coverage, occupancy, diversity, QD score (secondary, reported, never a gate: refuse_endpoint('H3'))

arms.shared_caps_rule: cap_items and cap_bytes are one pair of numbers for all four arms (design H3: 'both the behavioral and random portions count against the same total caps; duplicate items do not silently expand capacity'); a seal that gives two arms different caps is REFUSED; count_bound and byte_bound are printed per arm per seed
arms.same_stream_rule: every arm replays the IDENTICAL ordered stream per seed (stream_digest equal across arms, asserted)

primary_contrasts.multiplicity: BONFERRONI over 3 (alpha 0.05 / 3 per interval); the three share the top_k arm and their induced correlation is printed (paired_contrasts_shared_arm)

secondary.hybrid_minus_behavioral: the reserve's marginal value; reported, not a gate
secondary.coverage_and_occupancy: reported per arm; NEVER an endpoint (refuse_endpoint)
secondary.costs: descriptor computation, ingestion, eviction, retrieval, adaptation charged per arm; a policy whose cost receipt is missing has its verdict withheld

practical_threshold.rationale: the smallest effect a retention policy can show on a 12-query manifest is one more query answered; a policy that cannot buy one query is not worth its cost. Fixed BEFORE the pilot on that ground; FROZEN_FROM_PILOT binds the VALUE after the pilot SD is seen, never moves it to the noise (SIZING_RULE.md)

declared_null.generator: score-permuted twin of each stream (the DEAD stream: scores permuted across candidates, descriptors and bytes kept), replayed through the same four policies at the same caps and seed
declared_null.reference: H3_DEAD_STREAM_CONTROL_2026-09-11 (Apollo S1 shape): occupancy is identical live vs dead; only score-reading policies separate them
declared_null.attainable_range_of_statistic: each contrast in [-1, 1]; per seed the difference is a multiple of 1/12

controls_run_first.positive: a planted stream in which one descriptor cell holds every future-query answer: behavioral and hybrid must reach the ceiling, top_k must not (declared sign)
controls_run_first.negative: the dead stream: every contrast must be INCONCLUSIVE at the practical threshold and its false-SUPPORT rate at threshold 0 must sit at alpha/3 across seeds
controls_run_first.cheat: a cheat archive that reads the future-query labels must answer 12/12 on every seed; if it does not, the query channel cannot observe what the analysis claims to measure

eligible_count.definition: n_seeds whose four archives sealed with count_bound and byte_bound recorded and whose stream_digest is identical across arms

exclusions.rule: a seed is excluded only if its stream failed to seal (no stream_digest) or an arm's cost receipt is missing; the rule is identical across arms; every exclusion is listed with its seed and reason and COUNTED in the denominator report

decision_rule: SUPPORTED if the Bonferroni interval's lower bound exceeds the threshold; UNSUPPORTED if the upper bound is below it; else INCONCLUSIVE; INELIGIBLE if min_attainable_p > alpha. Each of the three contrasts decided separately; 'H3 supported' is never said of the lane unless hybrid_minus_topk is SUPPORTED
refusals: any diversity measure offered as the endpoint
a retrospective change to descriptor edges, bins, tie order, caps or the query manifest
an arm replayed on a different stream than the others
declared_n greater than the seed count
FROZEN claimed for a manifest whose seal addendum postdates a replay
n_seeds < 6 read as anything but NOTHING_COULD_FIRE
what_would_falsify_the_design: a positive control in which behavioral/hybrid fail to reach the planted ceiling shows the descriptor grid cannot see the planted structure and the analysis is void before any live seed is read
